import os,json
prog='/home/ubuntu/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-turns/play/users/u000/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(prog,exist_ok=True)
src='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    # marker color = most common non-bg color; seed = the other connected blob
    colors=[c for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg]
    marker=max(colors,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    # find seed blob: component of non-bg non-marker cells
    seen=set(); seed_cells=[]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c]!=bg and grid[r][c]!=marker and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
                while stack:
                    rr,cc=stack.pop()
                    if (rr,cc) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((rr,cc))
                    if grid[rr][cc]==bg or grid[rr][cc]==marker: continue
                    comp.append((rr,cc,grid[rr][cc]))
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            stack.append((rr+dr,cc+dc))
                if comp: seed_cells=comp
    sr=[r for r,c,v in seed_cells]; sc=[c for r,c,v in seed_cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(sr),max(sr),min(sc),max(sc)
    h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    seed=[[grid[r0+i][c0+j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    O=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if O[r][c]==marker: O[r][c]=bg
    for r in range(R):
        for c in range(C):
            if grid[r][c]==marker:
                tr,tc=r-h//2,c-w//2
                for i in range(h):
                    for j in range(w):
                        rr,cc=tr+i,tc+j
                        if 0<=rr<R and 0<=cc<C:
                            O[rr][cc]=seed[i][j]
    return O
'''
